### Streams in the Desert - November 1
Author: L. B. Cowman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/desert/streams-in-the-desert-november-1st.html
Passage: Numbers 9:19
Points:
- Remaining stationary while the cloud lingered served as Israel's greatest test of obedience.
- Moving is often exciting, but staying in an uncomfortable or perilous situation requires real patience.
- God frequently calls His followers to wait despite distress or threatening surroundings.
- While God asks us to remain at our post, He faithfully sustains us with His presence and daily provision.
- Believers must resist the temptation to rush ahead and instead wait until God clearly directs the next step.

### Bible Pathways - Feb. 16, 2009
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-feb-16-2009-11599329.html
Passage: Numbers 9:18
Points:
- The guiding cloud and pillar of fire visibly assured Israel of God's continual presence and care.
- The Lord sometimes leads His people into difficult or perplexing circumstances to strengthen their faith.
- Israel moved or stayed solely at the Lord's command rather than by human convenience or schedule.
- True strength and victory for believers come through trusting and remaining obedient to God's guidance.
